step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified user actor (UserConsumerMobile) connecting via device to the AWS entry point.
2. ELB routes traffic to API Management hosted on EC2.
3. API Management forwards requests to the Kubernetes cluster hosted on EC2.
4. The Kubernetes cluster connects to four backend destinations: MongoDB on EC2, RDS (PostgreSQL), ElastiCache, and an external Core Banking System (OnPremDC).
